name: Ultralight Black Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Black oak real wood veneer laminated onto 9mm recycled black acoustic felt, with no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer specifications override photo estimates: seven 1.20 in faces on 1.69 in pitches with 0.49 in wide, 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm deep in 9 mm felt, and 0.35 in total thickness; the exact pitches total 11.83 in rather than the nominal 11.80 in panel width. The tile is seven pitches wide and 23.66 in tall, with black oak veneer and black felt colors sampled from the main listing photo, and no rigid core.
